(() => { const pages = []; const seen = {}; const clean = (v) => String(v || '').replace(/&/g, '&').trim(); const abs = (v, b) => { try { return new URL(clean(v), b || location.href).href; } catch (e) { return clean(v); } }; const unwrap = (v, b) => { let url = abs(v, b); const encoded = url.match(/(https%3A%2F%2F[^\s"'<>]+?\.(?:jpg|jpeg|png|webp))(?:[?#].*)?$/i); if (encoded) { try { url = decodeURIComponent(encoded[1]); } catch (e) {} } return url; }; const usable = (url) => /\.(jpg|jpeg|png|webp)(\?|#|$)/i.test(url) && !/amazon|profile|blogmura|banner|icon|svg|with2\.net|hatena-module|blog_custom_icon/i.test(url); const push = (raw, pageUrl, width, height) => { const url = unwrap(raw, pageUrl || location.href); if (!url || /^data:/i.test(url) || !usable(url) || seen[url]) return; seen[url] = true; const item = { index: pages.length, page: pages.length, url, imageUrl: url }; const w = parseInt(String(width || ''), 10); const h = parseInt(String(height || ''), 10); if (w > 0) item.width = w; if (h > 0) item.height = h; pages.push(item); }; const collectImg = (img, pageUrl) => { if (!img) return; ['src','data-src','data-original','data-lazy-src','data-normalized-src','data-actualsrc','data-image'].forEach((name) => push(img.getAttribute(name) || '', pageUrl, img.getAttribute('width') || '', img.getAttribute('height') || '')); const srcset = clean(img.getAttribute('srcset') || img.getAttribute('data-srcset') || ''); srcset.split(',').forEach((part) => push(part.trim().split(/\s+/)[0] || '', pageUrl, img.getAttribute('width') || '', img.getAttribute('height') || '')); const link = img.closest ? img.closest('a[href]') : null; if (link) push(link.getAttribute('href') || '', pageUrl, img.getAttribute('width') || '', img.getAttribute('height') || ''); }; const fetchDoc = () => { try { const xhr = new XMLHttpRequest(); xhr.open('GET', location.href, false); xhr.setRequestHeader('Accept', 'text/html,application/xhtml+xml'); xhr.send(null); if (xhr.status >= 200 && xhr.status < 400 && xhr.responseText) return new DOMParser().parseFromString(xhr.responseText, 'text/html'); } catch (e) {} return null; }; const collectDoc = (doc) => { if (!doc) return; const root = doc.querySelector('.entry-content') || doc.querySelector('.entry-inner') || doc; root.querySelectorAll('img.hatena-fotolife, img[itemprop="image"], figure img, .entry-content img').forEach((img) => collectImg(img, location.href)); }; collectDoc(fetchDoc()); collectDoc(document); if (pages.length === 0) { const html = document.documentElement ? document.documentElement.outerHTML : ''; const re = /https?:\/\/[^"'\s<>]+?\.(?:jpg|jpeg|png|webp)(?:\?[^"'\s<>]*)?|https%3A%2F%2F[^"'\s<>]+?\.(?:jpg|jpeg|png|webp)/ig; let m = null; while ((m = re.exec(html)) !== null) push(m[0], location.href, '', ''); } return JSON.stringify(pages); })();

changes: Fixed reader page extraction returning an empty list on ArkWeb by parsing the fetched entry HTML.
Reader extraction now accepts Hatena lazy-load attributes, srcset, parent photo links and decoded Hatena proxy URLs.
Fixed archive list extraction returning empty results in WebView.
List workflows now parse fetched Hatenablog HTML with DOMParser and unwrap Hatena thumbnail proxy URLs.
Added GravureGalaxy source from current Hatenablog archive structure.
Supports latest, discovery, search, category filter, detail and original image extraction.
Filters out Amazon/sidebar/banner images from reader page list.
